_comment: C0-15 ollama bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（vllm/llama-cpp），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [llamaindex, openai-agents-sdk]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 第二段（models 站 GGUF 索引衔接句）照源译出。

axes.model_access: One-click pulls of open-source models from the official model library (ollama.com/search direct-fetched 200); GGUF and safetensors importable (docs.ollama.com/import direct-fetch verified); the library catalog shifts with listings — follow the ollama.com/search list for the day.
axes.runtime: A local process (CLI + API server, port 11434 by default). The official Cloud docs cover API keys, usage and plans; the Cloud FAQ states zero data retention (ZDR). GitHub 185,274★ (API verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Model weights and conversation data land on your machine by default. On Ollama Cloud, prompts and responses are processed transiently under ZDR — not stored, not logged, not used for training; the account keeps basic details and content-free usage metadata (Cloud FAQ).
axes.background: The resident API server carries background inference; keep_alive and concurrent-request queueing are described in the official local FAQ (OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE, parallel requests and VRAM queueing).
axes.tools: The official tool surface is the function-calling / tool-calling API (docs.ollama.com has a Tool calling page); the docs navigation does not list MCP integration, so MCP needs an external bridge and this dossier does not treat external bridges as official capability.
axes.context: Default context scales by VRAM: <24GiB 4k, 24–48GiB 32k, ≥48GiB 256k; cloud models default to the largest context (official Context length page). Cross-session memory is not part of the official docs narrative.
axes.permissions: Runs locally with no account needed (the API server listens locally by default); the cloud line signs in with an Ollama account / API key, managed in settings, with the data surface governed by the Cloud FAQ ZDR and account-deletion terms.
axes.fit: Fits: getting an open-source model running with one command, wanting an OpenAI-compatible local API, desktop and server alike. Does not fit: maximum throughput/service scheduling (that is vLLM/SGLang's job); hard requirements on cloud data boundaries (read the Cloud FAQ ZDR terms first).

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the local-endpoint and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no runner-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
The models site's GGUF index framing (llama.cpp as the format source) connects with this dossier's model_access axis.
unknowns:
- The full model-library catalog and each weight's license (changes with listings and weight pages; follow the model page)
- MCP integration (the official docs navigation does not list MCP; this dossier records only the tool-calling API and does not infer external bridges)
related: Both open-source model runners: vLLM leads on service-style high throughput, Ollama on single-machine out-of-the-box.
The GGUF ecosystem root Ollama depends on underneath; for fine-grained control use llama.cpp directly.
